name: strike-screen-matrix
notes: SUPERSEDED by run-strike-screen-fits-L1.json and run-strike-screen-fits-L3.json (protocol revision 3): the fractional design below was the pre-execution-path plan; the executable screen is the full 2 arms x 2 encoders x 2 losses x 2 folds grid of those documents. Kept for the record; do not run. ADR-0270 section 3-4 fractional design as pure data (PROPOSED; ZERO fits until the registration is approved). Each document is the strike-screen-experiment-template.json CDFExperiment with its arms restricted to `arm`, its candidates restricted to `candidates`, training.losses set to the named recipe, and training epochs/patience plus fold_table roles set by the stage. The pilot-root prepare script materializes them; this file never trains. Change the design here, never in code.

losses.notes: One global + one local term per recipe (TorchCDF composite). Training losses are never compared across kinds; recipes are compared on the scored metrics only.

documents.notes: D-L1T is the L1 recipe on the theta-augmented arm (sparse Theta coverage, disclosed as mostly fit-only median imputation).

stage1.notes: Correctness and timing pilot: fixed epochs, no early stop, warm-up fold only. Stop rule: if max(seconds_per_epoch) * stage2.epochs * stage2 neural cells > stop_rule_seconds, drop stop_rule_drop_order from stage2 in that order before it starts.

stage2.notes: Compact screen. Documents run in `order` so an interruption leaves complete recipes. A fit hitting the epoch ceiling while improving is a consumed, flagged 'ceiling' skip, never retried, and joins the audit set.

promotion.notes: Fixed before any outcome (ADR-0270 section 4). Screening reports read only scored origins before screening_end_before; the masked slice is scored by every fit but opened only at the separately registered promotion rung.

caps.notes: Per-packet resource caps. Disk and file-size caps are observational (du poll between documents, RLIMIT_FSIZE), not quotas. One CUDA process at a time; an interrupted cell is consumed.
